LESSON: MY EXTENDED FAMILY

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.1: My extended family

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My extended family. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name correctly three (Suggested time: 8 lessons) sounds of Arabic alphabet with vowels
2. write the Arabic alphabet from right to left adding the vowels on them pairs or small groups. Arabic alphabet with vowels through digital literacy and games. displayed Arabic alphabet with vowels to read. orientation of reading and writing the Arabic alphabet with vowels (right to left) writing and writing activities e.g.. modelling Arabic alphabet and vowels.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name correctly three (Suggested time: 8 lessons) sounds of Arabic alphabet with vowels
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name correctly three (Suggested time: 8 lessons) sounds of Arabic alphabet with vowels. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. write the Arabic alphabet from right to left adding the vowels on them pairs or small groups. Arabic alphabet with vowels through digital literacy and games. displayed Arabic alphabet with vowels to read. orientation of reading and writing the Arabic alphabet with vowels (right to left) writing and writing activities e.g.. modelling Arabic alphabet and vowels.

Arabic alphabet with vowels through digital literacy and games. displayed Arabic alphabet with vowels to read. orientation of reading and writing the Arabic alphabet with vowels (right to left) writing and writing activities e.g.. modelling Arabic alphabet and vowels. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My extended family.
2. Explain My extended family to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My extended family.
4. Show that you can: name correctly three (Suggested time: 8 lessons) sounds of Arabic alphabet with vowels
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My extended family. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is My extended family important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name correctly three (Suggested time: 8 lessons) sounds of Arabic alphabet with vowels
2. write the Arabic alphabet from right to left adding the vowels on them pairs or small groups.
